name: softicon-related-posts
description: Related posts by category, tag or any taxonomy, with a Gutenberg block

scripts.i18n: npm run i18n-pot && npm run i18n-json && npm run i18n-mo
scripts.zip: npm run build && npm run i18n && npm run find-ds && rm -f softicon-related-posts.zip && cd .. && zip -r softicon-related-posts/softicon-related-posts.zip softicon-related-posts/softicon-related-posts.php softicon-related-posts/index.php softicon-related-posts/uninstall.php softicon-related-posts/includes softicon-related-posts/templates softicon-related-posts/assets softicon-related-posts/build softicon-related-posts/languages softicon-related-posts/readme.txt -x '*/.DS_Store' '*/.map'
scripts.bundle: npm run lint && npm run zip
